title: A finite relation becomes trivial at a stage of a flat colimit
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a nonempty directed preorder, $A,B:\Lambda\to\mathrm{CommRing}$ and $N:\Lambda\to\mathrm{Ab}$ functors with categorical colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Give each $N_i$ a $B_i$-module structure, with transition maps $\eta_f$ semilinear over $\beta_f$. Let $\varphi_i:A_i\to B_i$ be ring maps with $\beta_f\varphi_i=\varphi_j\alpha_f$, and let $\psi:A_\infty\to B_\infty$ satisfy $\psi a_i=b_i\varphi_i$. Give $N_\infty$ a $B_\infty$-module structure whose coprojections $n_i$ are semilinear over $b_i$, and assume it is flat over $A_\infty$ through $\psi$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Fix $i$, a finite type $P$, coefficients $a_p\in A_i$ and vectors $x_p\in N_i$ with $\sum_p\varphi_i(a_p)x_p=0$. There exist $j$, $f:i\to j$, an integer $m\ge0$, coefficients $c_{pq}\in A_j$ and vectors $y_q\in N_j$ for $q\in\mathrm{Fin}(m)$ such that $\eta_f(x_p)=\sum_q\varphi_j(c_{pq})y_q$ for every $p$, and $\sum_p\alpha_f(a_p)c_{pq}=0$ for every $q$. No Noetherian, finite-module, local-ring, or injectivity assumption is imposed.

source.place: Algebra, Tags 00HK (equational flatness) and 00R6 (finite-stage kernel descent).

proof.text: Map the relation to N_infty using scalar compatibility and psi*a_i=b_i*phi_i. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-equational-criterion] to the resulting relation in the flat A_infty-module N_infty. It gives finitely many coefficients C_pq and vectors Y_q with n_i(x_p)=sum_q C_pq*Y_q and sum_p a_i(a_p)*C_pq=0.

Use representatives in the ring colimit from [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-algebras-elementwise] (ring Z), and representatives in the additive-group colimit (abelian groups as Z-modules) from [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise]. Directedness puts the finite representatives at one stage mu above i.

At mu form the column sums and differences of the row expressions. Compatibility of transitions, phi and coprojections shows their images are zero. Use [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-rings-zero] for the column sums and eventual equality from [lem-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-modules-elementwise] for the row differences. Directedness gives one later j where all finitely many equations hold; ring and module transitions preserve these equations. The images of the representatives c_pq,y_q at j give the claimed factorization.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stage_flat_relation_factorization
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty Λ]
    (A : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{w})
    (N : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{z}) [HasColimit A] [HasColimit B] [HasColimit N]
    [∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (N.obj i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (B.map f).hom.comp (φ i) = (φ j).comp (A.map f).hom)
    (hscalar : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (N.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (N.map f).hom x)
    (ψ : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) →+* (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}))
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι A i).hom = (colimit.ι B i).hom.comp (φ i))
    [Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z})]
    (hlimitScalar : ∀ (i : Λ) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (colimit.ι N i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι N i).hom x)
    (hflat : letI := Module.compHom (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z}) ψ
      Module.Flat (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z}))
    (i : Λ) {ι : Type t} [Fintype ι] (a : ι → A.obj i) (x : ι → N.obj i)
    (hx : ∑ p, (φ i) (a p) • x p = 0) :
    ∃ (j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (m : ℕ)
      (c : ι → Fin m → A.obj j) (y : Fin m → N.obj j),
      (∀ p, (N.map f).hom (x p) = ∑ q, (φ j) (c p q) • y q) ∧
      (∀ q, ∑ p, (A.map f).hom (a p) * c p q = 0)
